blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Letran turned to Jimboy Estrada in the clutch anew to squeak past Perpetual Help, 85-83, in a thriller in the NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball tournament on Tuesday at San Juan Arena. With the Knights trailing by one, Estrada banked in a contested step back triple to win it with 2.2 ticks to go, allowing his team to enter the quarterfinals with a 9-4 record as the top seed in Group B. “When it comes to those kinds of last plays, coach Allen (Ricardo) really gives me his trust,” Estrada said in Filipino after dropping 19 points, four assists and […]...
